design_status: Specified after startup benchmark and before any downstream acquisition results
primary_endpoint: Original Fold-B1-q20 accuracy normalized trapezoidal AULC B16-B80, every integer budget
secondary_early_endpoint: B8-B80 accuracy AULC with explicit startup predictor; not historically identical
split_policy: All100 original input-only Week11 partitions, executed anew under developmental protocols
budget_policy: Every startup and refinement label is paid; no reset at discovery
startup_predictor: Beta(1,1) posterior mean (ones+1)/(queried+2) while prescribed initialization is unfinished; never called M3
model: Unmodified historical M3; identical split/budget seed namespace across arms
inference: Descriptive paired repeat-block contrasts and conditional partition bootstrap intervals; no confirmation or replacement decision
startup_rules: startup/benchmark/config.json; the superseded implementation-error-v0 outputs are excluded
failure_policy: Retain path, diagnostics and error; do not silently discard, reseed, tune, or summarize incomplete comparisons
why_eight_complete_protocols: Three historical structures plus matched early-margin attribution, three startup controls at B8, and one random acquisition control; only existing margin/coverage/random refinement rules
